recommendation: Keep the source fix. It completes the published Pharmacy decision while preserving later scope clarifications; no further core source change is recommended for FHIR-7405.
issue_request: FHIR-7405 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for DSTU1. It asked to replace list/summary-sounding MedicationStatement common-usage examples with wording for medication use, each medication in an intake medication list, and a medication represented within an active-medication summary.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-7405. The Jira comment said it was already done, and commit 7d50996061 (#7167) added the current paragraph saying MedicationStatement does not produce a medication list but does produce individual medication statements for Lists. The specific common-usage bullets identified by FHIR-7405 survived unchanged through later history until this reconciliation.
additional_context: FHIR-5916 raised the same second and third MedicationStatement usage bullets and points to the same #7167/#5941 application trail. FHIR-5941 is a supporting MedicationAdministration/MedicationStatement boundary decision already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-38682 renamed MedicationUsage back to MedicationStatement while stating scope did not change. FHIR-39165 later removed non-prescribed substance-abuse/alcohol/tobacco use from scope, so the 2015 recreational-drug example was not restored verbatim.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml to use singular common-usage wording: medication use by a patient, each medication in an intake medication list, and representation of a medication in an active-medication summary. The first bullet was adapted to current scope as prescription or non-prescription medications.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml: updated the three common-usage bullets to singular wording and current medication-only scope.
